info.title: SeniorSocial API
info.summary: White-label city connection and services platform for residents 60+
info.description: Every operational resource is scoped by org_id and every response is scoped to the caller's organisation. Cross-org access returns 404, never 403, so that the existence of another organisation's records is not disclosed. All people in every environment of this API are synthetic.

sessionCookie.name: ss_session
sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax session cookie issued by /auth/verify or /auth/demo-code. There is no bearer-token surface in the MVP; a future City IdP arrives as an additional OIDC scheme, never as a replacement.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required retry key scoped to organisation, authenticated actor, operation, and target. Authorization is checked before replay. The server atomically claims concurrent requests and preserves the original successful status and body for same-key, same-content retries without repeating mutations; reuse with different canonical validated content returns 409. Retention must cover documented client retry windows and must not silently expire within them.

Forbidden.description: authenticated but not permitted - consent scope or role check failed server-side

NotFound.description: not found in the caller's organisation - also returned for cross-org access

Conflict.description: the request conflicts with current state, an expected version, or prior idempotency-key content

AiDisabled.description: this AI feature is switched off - the human route is in the problem detail
